source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent paint roller and swash progressing from pale construction to bold felt-tip outlines and saturated marker color.
source.notes: Keep one face-free paint roller angled from a lower-right grip to an upper-left roller cover, one bent metal frame, one broad paint swash behind it, exactly two rounded drips, exactly two detached paint droplets, one grip hole, two roller highlight gaps, and one shallow broken shadow stable. No hand, wall, paint can, brush, face, lettering, logo, border, sticker edge, badge frame, label, arrow, number, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only flourish.

process_strategy: Lock the roller axis, cylinder ends, bent-frame route, grip footprint, swash boundary, two drip positions, two droplet positions, highlight gaps, and shadow before inking; clarify the roller hardware and every paint edge before adding color; then deepen only established fills and outlines in the final frame.

final_elements.description: Pale construction places one diagonal roller, one paint swash, exactly two drips, two detached droplets, two roller highlights, and one shallow broken shadow.

final_elements.name: complete roller cover, bent metal frame, and tapered grip silhouettes
final_elements.description: The cylinder, frame bends, ferrule, and grip become one readable paint-roller silhouette with clear overlaps.

final_elements.name: broad paint swash, two rounded drips, two detached droplets, grip hole, two roller highlights, and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Every paint edge, drip, droplet, hardware detail, highlight reserve, and shadow appears before the black and color passes.

final_elements.name: thick imperfect black felt-tip outlines and clarified roller-over-swash overlaps
final_elements.description: Bold handmade marker reinforces every existing roller, frame, grip, swash, drip, droplet, highlight, and shadow boundary.

final_elements.name: tangerine paint, deep-navy grip, cool-gray frame, paper highlights, and warm-gray shadow
final_elements.description: A limited retro palette fills the roller cover and swash tangerine, grip deep navy, frame cool gray, and shadow warm gray with visible marker texture.

rejection_checks: The same roller angle, cover shape, bent-frame route, grip footprint, swash boundary, two drip positions, two droplet positions, crop, and scale must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one roller, one swash, two drips, and two detached droplets must appear before the final panel and persist.
No hand, wall, paint can, brush, face, lettering, logo, border, sticker edge, badge frame, label, arrow, number, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only flourish may appear.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and handmade edge variation rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
